The '''Badawzi Fortress''' was the home and base of operations of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Abdi-Badawzi]]. It was located to the north-east of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vakeyya]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
